First public release of **howtui**, an AI command assistant that lives inside your terminal. Describe a task, edit the
suggested shell command in a small inline UI, and get it on stdout or straight into your next prompt. howtui never runs
commands for you.

## Install

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hungryZoo/howtui/main/scripts/install.sh | sh     # Linux, macOS
```

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hungryZoo/howtui/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex           # Windows
```

The installer verifies `SHA256SUMS`, installs without admin rights, and asks once whether to enable shell integration
(nothing in your rc files or profiles changes without a yes). Run `howtui`; the first run signs you in with ChatGPT.

## Highlights

- Inline UI (10 lines by default, no alternate screen): ask, edit the command, ask for changes, Enter to accept
- Sign in with ChatGPT using your ChatGPT plan, with a two-step sign-in screen and redirect URL paste for SSH machines
- Settings view (Ctrl+O, `/model`, or a click on the model name): pick the model, see the account, sign out. Default model GPT-6-Luna when your account lists it
- Shell integration for Bash, Zsh and PowerShell: Ctrl+G edits the current command line, a typed `howtui` fills the next prompt
- Clean stdout for `cmd=$(howtui)` and pipes, `--no-tui` for scripts, rule-based danger hints with a second Enter for high-risk commands
- English and Korean UI
- Uninstall script installed next to the binary (`howtui-uninstall.sh`, `howtui-uninstall.ps1`)

## Assets

Seven targets: Linux x86_64, ARM64 and ARMv7 (glibc 2.17+), macOS Apple Silicon and Intel (11+), Windows x64 and ARM64.
Verify a download with `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing` and the build provenance with
`gh attestation verify <file> --repo hungryZoo/howtui`. Binaries are not code-signed or notarized.

## Known limits

- Sign in with ChatGPT is a limited preview on OpenAI's side; if plan usage is not enabled for howtui, it cannot be used yet.
- Not tested on hardware: Raspberry Pi, Windows on ARM (CI only), Intel Macs (build checks only), Windows with code page 949.
- While the UI is open it receives mouse clicks; select terminal text with Shift+drag or set `ui.mouse = false`.
